text: Over the last 30 days, visitor reviews for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have highlighted issues with the food offerings. Two reviews mentioned the limited menu range, with one describing the venison chili as bland and another calling the food overpriced and minimal. There was also a complaint about service related to the refusal to provide cups for water. Overall, the average rating was low, indicating dissatisfaction that should be addressed.

windows.60: Over the past 60 days, several visitors have expressed concerns about the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting bland flavors and limited menu options. Service issues and wait times were also mentioned in multiple reviews. One visitor specifically pointed out the lack of cups for water and described the food as overpriced and minimal. While some healthy food choices were appreciated, there is a clear need to improve both the taste and variety of offerings. Overall, the average rating was moderate, reflecting mixed experiences.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported that the menu is limited and some dishes were bland or poorly prepared, with specific complaints about the quality and variety of options. There were also multiple comments about long wait times and inconsistent service, including periods when ordering was unavailable due to kitchen delays. Pricing was frequently described as too high for the portion sizes and quality offered. Addressing these concerns could improve the overall visitor experience.
